selection.method: PixelLab v3 custom animation generated 7 frames (index 0 = start-pose reference matching the character's existing north-east standing rotation, indices 1-6 = one full walk cycle). Both selected frames were re-cropped from the generator's 224x224 canvas to the family's 180x180 canvas using a fixed +22/+22 pixel offset derived by comparing the index-0 reference frame's non-transparent bounding box to the existing standing/north-east.png bounding box; the offset was confirmed against the existing frame_000-frame_003 bounding boxes (x=57-58 in both). This crop is a pixel-exact region copy with zero anti-aliased/partial-alpha pixels introduced (verified 0 of 32400 pixels with 0<alpha<255 in each selected frame) -- no hand-painting or resampling was applied.
selection.frame_004_source: generated frame index 1 of animation asset 1a6e4335-a4e3-462d-8e2d-f6b297772d1b, cropped to (22,22)-(202,202) of the 224x224 output

selection.continuity_basis: Selected the two candidate frames whose non-transparent bounding boxes (x=57-58, y top=10-11) most closely matched the ground-contact and horizontal alignment of the existing frames_000-003, preserving the hat, feminine-light skin/hair, blue-black wizard costume, and north-east back-facing camera established by those frames, so the six frames read as one continuous walking loop.
